items.hed: Winless Texans host Dallas on Sunday at noon Central
items.insight: Houston is 0-3 after losses to Buffalo, Cincinnati and Indianapolis. The club schedule lists Dallas at Reliant Stadium on Sunday, Oct. 4, at noon Central, followed by a trip to Tennessee on Oct. 11.

items.hed: Astros’ season ends in a Wild Card Series sweep by the White Sox
items.insight: Chicago beat Houston 6-3 on Sept. 29 and 7-3 on Sept. 30 at Daikin Park to take the best-of-three series. The Astros had closed the regular season by outscoring the Athletics 22-2 over the final weekend.

items.hed: Rockets open the preseason Oct. 9 against Dallas in Macao
items.insight: The NBA lists Houston and Dallas for two preseason games in Macao, on Oct. 9 and Oct. 11. They are the Rockets’ first games of the new season.
